title: Settlement payouts, STK fixes, and clearer client status
items: Settlement payout method: choose phone number, till/paybill, or bank (dropdown, paybill, account number) — not phone-only.
Fixed staff-initiated STK push failing with "invalid phone number" or "gateway not configured" for platform-collected tenants.
SMS broadcasts, bulk messages, and outage alerts now send once per customer, not once per PPPoE line.
Clients list: Plan/Router/Expiry moved under each account's Services tab; Status now shows Online, last seen, or Blocked.
Payout failures are now logged server-side instead of only showing in the browser.
